content.value_statement: Moving templates between email providers can break variables, conditionals, and send calls. This skill converts provider syntax to Mailtrap Handlebars and flags changes that need review.
actual_capabilities: Converts templates from SendGrid, Mailgun, Mandrill, Postmark, Brevo, and Amazon SES.
Processes one HTML file, a directory of HTML files, or pasted template HTML.
Flags unsupported helpers, filters, editable regions, and ambiguous closing tags.
Generates conversion reports with change counts and manual review notes.
Maps provider API fields to Mailtrap template UUID and template variables.
Guides testing with Mailtrap Email Testing before production use.
limitations: The source email provider must be known before conversion starts.
Custom helpers and date formatting must move to application code.
Complex Brevo loops and filters may require manual review.
The skill does not verify API tokens or create templates automatically unless the user runs the documented API steps.

use_cases.title: Move a SendGrid Template
use_cases.description: Convert a transactional SendGrid template to Mailtrap syntax and identify application changes for helpers.

use_cases.title: Migrate a Template Library
use_cases.description: Convert a directory of provider templates and review reports before uploading them to Mailtrap.

use_cases.title: Validate Rendered Messages
use_cases.description: Use the testing guidance to confirm variables, conditionals, loops, HTML, and text output before production sends.

prompt_templates.title: Convert One Template
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert this SendGrid HTML file to Mailtrap Handlebars. Put output in a converted folder and summarize all flags.

prompt_templates.title: Convert Pasted HTML
prompt_templates.prompt: I pasted a Postmark template below. Convert it inline, list every syntax change, and mark anything needing review.

prompt_templates.title: Bulk Convert Directory
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert all Mailgun templates in this directory to Mailtrap format. Give a file-by-file summary and list review items.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Provider Migration
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these Brevo templates, convert safe syntax, explain application-layer changes, and create a Mailtrap Email Testing checklist.

output_examples.input: A SendGrid welcome template with insert defaults and a date helper.
output: Converted insert defaults to Mailtrap conditional blocks.
Flagged the date helper for application-side formatting.
Reported one automatic change and one manual review item.

output_examples.input: A directory of Postmark templates for receipts and password resets.
output: Converted recognized conditionals and unescaped variables.
Generated per-template reports and a bulk summary.
Marked one ambiguous closing tag for verification.

output_examples.input: A Brevo template with loops, filters, and nested variables.
output: Converted safe variable and loop syntax.
Flagged unsupported filters for application-side logic.
Recommended manual review for nested loop context.

best_practices: Back up original templates before writing converted output.
Review every flagged pattern before uploading a template to Mailtrap.
Test each migrated template in Mailtrap Email Testing before production sends.
anti_patterns: Do not convert templates from multiple providers in one batch.
Do not ignore helper flags that require application code changes.
Do not hardcode Mailtrap tokens or account identifiers in templates or scripts.

faq.question: Which providers are supported?
faq.answer: The skill supports SendGrid, Mailgun, Mandrill, Postmark, Brevo, and Amazon SES templates.

faq.question: Does it upload templates to Mailtrap?
faq.answer: It mainly converts syntax and explains API steps. Users must run API commands or upload through the Mailtrap UI.

faq.question: Can it process many files?
faq.answer: Yes. It can convert a directory of HTML files and produce a bulk summary report.

faq.question: What happens to unsupported helpers?
faq.answer: Unsupported helpers are flagged. The skill explains what must move to application code.

faq.question: Can it convert pasted HTML?
faq.answer: Yes. Inline HTML uses deep conversion and returns converted Handlebars with a change summary.

faq.question: Does it preserve HTML and CSS?
faq.answer: It is designed to preserve HTML structure and CSS while changing only template syntax.
